note: 1/4 scale paid protocol run; unofficial answer judges (token-F1/EM and abstention rule) instead of official LongMemEval LLM judge. Full-scale runs remain pending.

longmemeval_answer_quarter.finding: evidence retrieval is strong (0.8075) and single-session QA is usable (0.43), but multi-session reasoning is the bottleneck (0.036); head+tail evidence truncation likely hurts cross-session answers.

qasper_context_paired_quarter.finding: within the 2pp quality budget on every metric (Answer F1 -0.2pp to +0.2pp), but QASPER validation papers mostly fit the 6656-token budget, so mean token reduction is only 6%; the 50% reduction guardrail needs papers that actually exceed the budget (see full-paper Context diagnostic).
